title: Manage Game Default
caption: Default loaded Manage Game view for a supported library title.
instructions: Open a game in the Steam library and wait for the Manage Game view to finish loading.

title: Manage Game Report Detail
caption: Manage Game detail view showing the selected report preview and actions.
instructions: From Manage Game, open one report and pause on its detail view.

title: Manage Game Hardware Compare
caption: Side-by-side comparison between the report hardware and our current system.
instructions: From the report detail view, open the System Comparison modal.

title: Manage Game Matching Guide
caption: How Matching Works modal explaining relevance score and per-field comparison thresholds.
instructions: From the hardware comparison modal, open How Matching Works.

title: Manage Game System Requirements
caption: System Requirements modal showing parsed game requirements alongside the hardware comparison flow.
instructions: From the hardware comparison modal, open System Requirements.

title: Manage Game Edit Modal
caption: Edit modal used to change RAM, notes, and other report-derived launch settings.
instructions: From the report detail view, choose Edit and capture the modal with fields visible.

title: Manage Game Upload Destination
caption: Upload destination picker offering ProtonDB and Proton Pulse upload paths from the report detail view.
instructions: From the report detail view, open the Upload destination picker.

title: Manage Configurations Default
caption: Manage Configurations screen with profile controls and launch option toggles.
instructions: Open the Manage Configurations page from the plugin sidebar.

title: Manage Configurations Config Editor
caption: Config editor modal for building a reusable launch profile with filtered toggle sections.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations and open the new config editor modal.

title: Manage Configurations Existing Config Editor
caption: Config editor modal opened on an existing saved profile with launch options and toggles already populated.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations and open the config editor on a saved profile.

title: Manage Configurations ProtonDB Submit
caption: Submit-to-ProtonDB modal with generated system information ready to copy.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations and open the ProtonDB submit modal for the current game.

title: Manage Configurations Native Pulse Report
caption: Native Proton Pulse report modal with hardware, launch options, and report fields filled in.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations and open the native Proton Pulse report modal for the selected game.

title: Manage Configurations Upload Preview
caption: Apply preview modal showing the launch options and detected hardware before saving a configuration.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations, open an existing profile, and show the apply preview modal.

title: Manage Configurations Custom Toggles
caption: Custom toggle manager for per-game and global launch option snippets.
instructions: Open Manage Configurations, open the config editor, and open Custom Toggles.

title: Compatibility Tools Tab
caption: Compatibility tools screen showing discovered Proton versions and actions.
instructions: Open the Compatibility Tools page from the plugin navigation.

title: Compatibility Tools Release Picker
caption: Compatibility tools picker focused on Proton release selection.
instructions: Open the Compatibility Tools page and open the version browser.

title: Compatibility Tools Install From ZIP
caption: Archive installer modal for importing a custom compatibility tool from a local file.
instructions: Open Compatibility Tools and open the Install from ZIP modal.

title: Compatibility Tools Active Install
caption: Compatibility tools screen while a Proton-GE install is in progress with live progress stats visible.
instructions: Open Compatibility Tools and capture the active install progress state.

title: Manage Game Launch Option Conflict
caption: Conflict prompt shown when Steam already has launch options and Proton Pulse is about to apply a different configuration.
instructions: Open the launch option conflict prompt from Manage Game before applying a new configuration.

title: Logs Tab
caption: Logs tab overview with recent entries and the entry count before opening the full viewer.
instructions: Open the Logs tab and leave the base tab view visible.

title: Logs Viewer
caption: Log viewer modal with scrolling content and actions visible.
instructions: Open the Logs tab and bring up the full log viewer.

title: Settings General
caption: Main settings page showing the general configuration controls.
instructions: Open the Settings tab and keep the default general settings section visible.

title: Settings Local Data Backup
caption: Advanced settings section for exporting and restoring local Proton Pulse data.
instructions: Open Settings, enable advanced settings if needed, and scroll to the local data backup section.

title: Settings Proton Pulse Account Linking
caption: Account linking section with installation ID, link code, and profile actions.
instructions: Open Settings and scroll to the Proton Pulse account linking section.

title: Settings My Hardware Section
caption: My Hardware settings section with view, upload, and profile actions.
instructions: Open Settings and scroll to the My Hardware section.

title: My Hardware Modal
caption: Full-screen hardware information modal showing ProtonDB-compatible system details.
instructions: Open Settings and open the My Hardware modal.

title: Settings Advanced Controls
caption: Advanced settings controls for experimental shortcuts, CEF debugging, cache TTL, and diagnostics.
instructions: Open Settings, enable advanced settings, and capture the advanced controls.

title: Cache Manager Modal
caption: Cache manager modal used to inspect and clear plugin cache state.
instructions: Open the Cache Manager modal from Settings.

title: Settings Language Selector
caption: Settings flow while changing the plugin language and verifying translated UI.
instructions: Open Settings and open the language selector.

title: Issue Reporting Template Selector
caption: About page with the issue template selector opened for choosing the report type.
instructions: Open the About tab and open the issue template selector.

title: About Tab
caption: About page with project summary and project links.
instructions: Open the About tab from the plugin navigation.
